explanationMd: The argument moves from a proxy-ranking failure to a decision-specific defense of testing. It distinguishes a useful screen from a universal durability measure and asks what inference the procedure actually supports.

distractorRationale.c: The author explicitly preserves a screening role.
distractorRationale.a: The outdoor comparison disproves that inference.
distractorRationale.d: The passage recommends bounded interpretation, not abandoning tests.
distractorRationale.b: The passage recognizes costs and legitimate screening uses.
